text: Do you even need flies if you're already pressing?
A fly is a hugging motion. Your arms sweep together, but your elbows stay fixed.
Cable flies keep tension the whole way. The pec deck is the most stable. Dumbbell flies load the stretch, but go easy at the top.
Flies aren't required, but they're a great finisher after your presses.
